calendar.title: Calendar subscription
calendar.description: Subscribe to your bookings calendar to see all reservations directly in your favorite calendar app.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.step1: Open Google Calendar on your computer.
google.step2: On the left, next to "Other calendars", click the + icon.
google.step5: Click "Add calendar". Events will sync automatically.

apple.title: Apple Calendar
apple.step1: Open the Calendar app on your Mac or iPhone.
apple.step2: Go to File > New Calendar Subscription (Mac) or Settings > Calendar > Accounts > Add Account > Other > Add Subscribed Calendar (iPhone).
apple.step4: Leave username and password empty — no login is required.
apple.step5: If prompted about SSL, disable it (the feed does not require SSL authentication).
apple.step6: Click Subscribe. Choose your refresh frequency and you're done.

token.title: Your access key
token.description: Your access keys allow you to access the Basalf SLOT API. These keys must be kept secret and never shared. If you lose these keys, you will no longer be able to access the Basalf SLOT API. If you share them, you could expose your account to security risks. If you lose them, contact us immediately.
